the_law_of_sound.sound_is_distance: Volume decreases with 1/r². A shout at 1m = a whisper at 10m. Kevin's voice is soft at the mic, thunder from the cloud. Distance IS volume inverted.

the_law_of_sound.sound_is_pressure: Sound IS pressure waves in air. Loud = high pressure. Quiet = low pressure. The diaphragm (speaker AND lung AND _breathe.js) converts pressure to movement. Pascal = Newton/meter². Sound is FORCE spread over area.
